summary: HisabKitab Android ledger app frontend successfully tested via Playwright. Verified app lock screen with PIN/Biometric unlock, dashboard financial summary and party navigation, transaction recording (You Gave / You Got), itemized billing with GST toggle, reports PDF export summary, and settings profile/language toggle.
critical_code_review_comments: Clean React Native mobile architecture with Expo Router and local storage synchronization.
Robust testID coverage across all interactive components and screens.
seed_data_creation: Mock data seeded via StorageService for parties, transactions, bills, and business profile.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core HisabKitab user flows verified successfully in web preview.
